title: The Arena

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Gain Access to the Goblin Town

body:
Description


The goblin arena serves the point of a combat challenge and a gateway to the goblin town. The Arena consists of 10 waves with increasing difficulty.

How to Begin the Arena

Talk to the arena master and agree to fight; you have to have the acid crown equipped for your first completion of the quest. Once this happens, you will have to fight a constant army of goblins through 10 waves total before the door beside the Goblin Arena Master opens. Once this happens, you will gain access to the Goblin town.
